think_procedure: 1) Identify the knob’s type and valid range from PostgreSQL documentation. 2) Check whether the knob has any sentinel numeric values (e.g., -1, 0) that switch it into a qualitatively different mode (disable/auto/special behavior) rather than just scaling the same behavior. 3) If such sentinel values exist, classify as a special knob and record those values; otherwise classify as non-special.
